summary: List Financial Periods with project status snapshots
description: Returns all Financial Periods for the company that have at least one project status snapshot attached, paginated by individual period and ordered by start date.

parameters.name: filters[budget_view_id]
parameters.description: Limit results to periods that have a snapshot on this budget view. When omitted, all periods with any PSS are returned.

parameters.name: filters[from_date]
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound of the date window (ISO 8601 date, "YYYY-MM-DD"). When provided, only periods ending on or after this date are returned. Optional; when omitted the window is unbounded below.

parameters.name: filters[to_date]
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound of the date window (ISO 8601 date, "YYYY-MM-DD"). When provided, only periods starting on or before this date are returned. Optional; when omitted the window is unbounded abov...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort periods by start date. `date` orders ascending (the default); `-date` orders descending.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of periods per page (default 10, max 100)

id.description: Unique identifier of the financial period. Use as the {id} path parameter to update a single period's status via PATCH /financial_periods/periods/{id}.

group_name.description: Name of the period group this period belongs to (e.g. "FY 2026"). Use as the {group_name} path parameter to update or delete the whole group.

name.description: Display name of the individual period within the group (e.g. "Q1 2026").

start_date.description: First day of the period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

end_date.description: Last day of the period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the period was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the period was last updated (ISO 8601).
